patterns.note: Stark, full-bleed color blocks that transition using textured, dithered, or spray-painted edges rather than clean vector lines.
High-contrast typography pairing massive, ultra-bold display sans-serifs with clean, functional body copy and tiny monospace labels for secondary actions.
A high-contrast palette of solid black, stark white, vibrant neon yellow, and soft lavender used to categorize information and highlight deceptive UI elements.
GSAP-driven scroll interactions where floating UI badges scatter and drift across the screen, mimicking the chaotic, overwhelming nature of dark pattern popups.
Interactive card decks that stack and slide horizontally to reveal content sequentially, mimicking a physical deck of cards.

technique_notes: To recreate the textured section transitions, use CSS masks or SVG filters with a high-contrast noise texture to create a dithered, spray-painted edge between solid color blocks.
Implement the floating badge chaos using GSAP ScrollTrigger to apply staggered parallax offsets and slight rotations to absolute-positioned elements as the user scrolls down.
The bottom navigation bar uses a fixed, pill-shaped container with a backdrop blur and subtle border, anchoring the experimental layout with a persistent, highly usable anchor.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, ultra-bold display headings (~6x body size) contrasted with compact, highly readable body text and tiny monospace utility labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on UI badges and cards, transitioning to a fully pill-shaped radius for the floating bottom navigation bar.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and expansive, utilizing massive vertical margins to let high-impact typography and floating interactive elements breathe.

standout: The site brilliantly visualizes 'dark patterns' by turning deceptive UI elements (like countdowns, cookie banners, and fake reviews) into floating, interactive design assets that scatter and react dynamically to the user's scroll.
